id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Deterministic full-duplex switched Ethernet star, duplicated as two physically independent networks (Network A and Network B). End Systems attach to AFDX Switches by point-to-point full-duplex links; Virtual Links define unidirectional source→destination(s) paths over the fabric.

supported_topologies.name: Point-to-point ES↔switch
supported_topologies.description: Full-duplex 10/100 Mbit/s link between an End System and an AFDX Switch.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-switch fabric
supported_topologies.description: AFDX Switches interconnect into a deterministic switched fabric.

supported_topologies.name: Dual redundant fabric
supported_topologies.description: Network A and Network B are fully independent (separate switches and cabling).

supported_topologies.name: Virtual Link multicast
supported_topologies.description: One source End System to one or more destination End Systems over a VL.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Avionics network interface: VL shaping (BAG/jitter), Sub-VL round-robin, Sequence-Number insertion, A/B replication, receive IC + RM.
Deterministic store-and-forward: VL-ID forwarding (static), per-VL policing, full-duplex links.
Unidirectional logical connection identified by a 16-bit VL ID in the dest MAC.

fields.interconnect_role: AFDX is a deterministic, redundant avionics network. Switches forward by VL ID and police each VL; End Systems shape to the BAG and reconcile the redundant A/B copies. Worst-case latency and bandwidth are bounded by offline configuration for certification.

ordering_guarantees.vl_sequence: Frames on a VL carry an incrementing Sequence Number used for Integrity Checking and duplicate suppression.
ordering_guarantees.redundancy: First-valid-wins delivery makes A/B redundancy transparent to the application.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Not memory-mapped: AFDX is a network. Addressing is the Virtual Link Identifier (in the dest MAC) plus UDP/IP ports identifying communication ports within an End System.

device_classification.DTE: Data Terminal Equipment — endpoint host (PC, server, IP camera, IoT device).
device_classification.DCE: Data Circuit-terminating Equipment — switch port, router port, repeater port.
device_classification.PHY: Single-port PHY transceiver; one MII / GMII / RGMII data path + one MDI port + management bus interface.
device_classification.Multi-port_PHY: N MII / GMII ports on one chip with internal switch fabric.
device_classification.Switch_ASIC: Many ports + forwarding engine; one MAC + PHY pair per port; STA bus drives all PHYs.
device_classification.NIC: Network Interface Controller — MAC + PHY + DMA engine + host bus interface (PCIe).
device_classification.end_system: Avionics LRU network interface performing VL shaping, redundancy, and integrity checking.
device_classification.afdx_switch: Deterministic store-and-forward switch forwarding by VL ID and policing each VL.
